what.text: This page follows refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6837 refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina in France, 27.7% of all refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Serbia and Kosovo is the largest host of refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina, followed by France and Denmark.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts in Bosnia-Herzegovina from 1992 to 1995, over Serb, Croat and Bihaca Krajina territory.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2006 to 2025, come long after those conflicts ended.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 649 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 6921, at the end of 2021.
It was slightly lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
